description: This file defines a class for compiling Smarty template code related to object block functions. It provides a method to set up callbacks and parameters for Smarty object block plugins during template compilation.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Private_Object_Block_Function
classes.description: A class responsible for compiling Smarty object block functions, particularly for registered objects used as block plugins in templates.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Prepares callback and parameter array for Smarty object block functions, returning configuration data for template compilation.
